hook.say: This morning: fewer than half of the stats AI assistants quote reach a study that says the same. I went back in to check.

findings.label: COPIED
findings.headline: of cited pages contained the exact figure AI quoted
findings.detail: So the assistants mostly did not invent numbers. They repeated pages that already had them.
findings.evidence: The numbers cited by the AI were present in 82% of the pages it cited.
findings.say: First, the assistants rarely invent numbers. The page they cited contained the figure 82% of the time. The problem is which page.

findings.label: BLOGS
findings.headline: of company-blog citations led to a real study
findings.detail: Company blogs were 54% of first citations. Government pages did far better.
findings.evidence: Company blog: 54% of first citations, 37% of them sourced.
findings.say: Second, more than half of first citations were company blogs, and only 37% of those led to a real study.

findings.label: VOLUME
findings.headline: numbers per answer from Claude, versus 1.3 for ChatGPT
findings.detail: The more numbers an assistant quotes, the more there is to verify.
findings.evidence: ChatGPT quoted the fewest numbers per answer (1.3); Claude quoted the most (6.8).
findings.say: Third, volume differs a lot. ChatGPT quoted 1.3 numbers per answer, Claude quoted 6.8, so more numbers means more to check.

take.headline: A quoted number is not a source.
take.say: My take: a quoted number is not a source. Trace it, and publish your own primary data so AI can trace it too.

sources.title: GIGAZINE: 40% of AI statistics are zombie statistics
daily.dev: Zombie stats, where the numbers AI quotes come from

caption:
This morning: fewer than half of the stats AI assistants quote lead to a study that says the same. I went back in to check.

The page AI cited had the figure 82% of the time. Only 37% of company-blog citations led to a real study. Claude quoted 6.8 numbers per answer, ChatGPT 1.3.

My take: a quoted number is not a source. Trace it, and publish your own primary data so AI can trace it too.

Comment GEO and I will send you the details by DM.

Sources in the first comment.
